buyer_question: Which patient, clinician, billing or operational workflow uses AI?
evidence_to_collect: AI use-case register; workflow diagram; user role list; intended-use note
adviser_question: Which use cases require formal legal/regulatory/clinical classification review?
unsafe_claim_to_block: Not regulated AI without owner-approved classification evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not EU AI Act advice or compliance proof

buyer_question: Could the workflow affect access, triage, diagnosis, treatment, safety or essential services?
evidence_to_collect: Classification screening note; risk register; rationale; decision date; reviewer names
adviser_question: Does qualified counsel/regulatory owner agree with the classification and next steps?
unsafe_claim_to_block: Low risk or high-risk ready without documented adviser review
boundary_label: Template row only; not high-risk classification advice

buyer_question: How does AI classification connect to data protection, special-category data and DPIA decisions?
evidence_to_collect: Data-flow map; lawful-basis note; DPIA screening; retention/deletion note; DPO comments
adviser_question: Is a DPIA, DPO review or processor/subprocessor wording update needed?
unsafe_claim_to_block: GDPR compliant or no DPIA needed without accountable approval
boundary_label: Template row only; not GDPR advice or DPIA approval

buyer_question: Who reviews AI outputs before clinical, patient access, billing or safety action?
evidence_to_collect: Human-review trigger list; escalation matrix; override log; training record
adviser_question: Are oversight controls adequate for the specific workflow and user group?
unsafe_claim_to_block: Fully automated clinical decisions without explicit review evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not clinical safety or medical advice

buyer_question: How are prompts, model versions, retrieval sources and regressions approved?
evidence_to_collect: Change log; regression test pack; rollback owner; release decision record
adviser_question: Which changes require reclassification, DPIA refresh or buyer notice?
unsafe_claim_to_block: No accuracy drift without monitoring and retest evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not accuracy or safety proof

buyer_question: Which AI vendors, subprocessors and data locations are involved?
evidence_to_collect: Vendor inventory; DPA/subprocessor list; data residency note; training-use evidence
adviser_question: What can be shared externally and what must stay under NDA or adviser review?
unsafe_claim_to_block: EU hosted or no training use without source evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not vendor certification evidence

buyer_question: What happens if AI usage, tokens, images, inference or support tickets scale?
evidence_to_collect: Usage dashboard; unit-cost assumptions; budget owner; alert and approval thresholds
adviser_question: Which spend thresholds require approval before production expansion?
unsafe_claim_to_block: Guaranteed savings or fixed AI cost without approved assumptions
boundary_label: Template row only; not savings ROI or revenue proof

buyer_question: What can sales, website, investor or procurement materials safely claim?
evidence_to_collect: Claim approval log; source links; owner sign-off; expiry/review date
adviser_question: Which compliance, accuracy, safety, customer, ranking or ROI claims must be removed?
unsafe_claim_to_block: EU AI Act compliant; clinically validated; customer-proven; ROI proven without evidence
boundary_label: Template row only; not customer testimonial or compliance proof
